plan.title: Exclude managed .deft/core from consumer Prettier / format gates

narratives.Description: Install and npm-managed update must deposit/heal a .prettierignore entry for managed .deft/core (and legacy deft/ when present) so consumer prettier --check . does not fail on the vendored payload. Do not try to make the deposit Prettier-clean for every consumer config.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

v0.76.0 vendored deposit fails consumer `prettier --check .` (~207 files under `.deft/core/`), blocking upgrades (e.g. BestiMax PR 100). Byte-matching every consumer Prettier version/config is not viable (#670 class).

## Product contract

Managed `.deft/core/` is outside the consumer format gate. Official install/update must ensure durable `.prettierignore` coverage (idempotent heal). Docs name the contract. Deposit-wide prettier --write is optional hygiene only, not acceptance.

## Non-goals

- Reformatting the content deposit as the primary fix
- Gitignoring `.deft/core` (committed payload remains #11)
- Every non-Prettier formatter in v1
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer upgrading Directive with a root Prettier gate, I want install/update to exclude managed .deft/core from Prettier automatically, so that task check passes without reformatting upstream content.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add EnsurePrettierIgnoreLines (or equivalent) in cmd/deft-install mirroring EnsureGitignoreLines: deposit `.deft/core/` and legacy `deft/` when applicable; idempotent; preserve consumer preamble.
2. Wire the same upkeep into the TS npm-managed path (packages/core/src/init-deposit refresh / directive-update) so updates heal ignores too.
3. Document the contract briefly in content/UPGRADING.md (and install guidance if needed).
4. Go + TS regression tests for create/append/idempotent heal.
5. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry. Closes #2534.
narratives.Acceptance:
1. Fresh install and official update leave root prettier --check . free of .deft/core failures
2. Idempotent second install/update
3. Docs name the contract
4. Tests cover deposit/heal
5. CHANGELOG entry

narrative.Acceptance: Given a consumer project without .prettierignore (or missing the entry), when deft-install / upgrade runs, then `.prettierignore` contains `.deft/core/` (and legacy `deft/` when that layout is active), without duplicating on a second run.

Given an npm-managed deposit refresh/update (directive-update / init-deposit refresh), when the update completes, then consumer `.prettierignore` is healed with the managed-core ignore entry idempotently.

Given UPGRADING (and/or install guidance), when a consumer reads it, then it states managed `.deft/core` is outside the consumer Prettier gate and install/update deposits the ignore; CHANGELOG [Unreleased] names the user-visible fix and closes #2534.
Given the Go installer and TS init-deposit test suites, when they run, then create/append/idempotent cases for `.prettierignore` pass.
